cases.html: <!DOCTYPE html><style>html,body{margin:0;background:#fff} video,audio{display:block}</style><script>const L=[],r2=x=>Math.round(x*100)/100,q=x=>Math.round(x*4)/4;const CT=(m,e)=>e.type=='seeking'||e.type=='seeked'?r2(m.currentTime):Math.floor(m.currentTime);const M=()=>document.querySelector('video,audio');const TG=e=>e.target===document?'doc':e.target===M()?'el':e.target.nodeName;const IN=['click','mousedown','mouseup','pointerdown','pointerup','dblclick'];const ME=['loadstart','error','loadedmetadata','loadeddata','canplay','playing','waiting','seeking','seeked','ended','durationchange','play','pause','ratechange','volumechange'];function log(m,tag,e){L.push((tag?tag+':':'')+e.type+'@'+TG(e)+' t='+(+e.isTrusted)+' p='+(+m.paused)+' ct='+CT(m,e)+(m.muted?' M':'')+' v='+m.volume)}function watch(m){ME.concat(IN).forEach(n=>m.addEventListener(n,e=>log(m,'',e)));IN.forEach(n=>document.addEventListener(n,e=>log(m,'D',e),true))}</script><video id=v src=long.mp4 controls preload=auto></video><script>watch(v)</script>

cases.html: <!DOCTYPE html><style>html,body{margin:0;background:#fff} video,audio{display:block}</style><script>const L=[],r2=x=>Math.round(x*100)/100,q=x=>Math.round(x*4)/4;const CT=(m,e)=>e.type=='seeking'||e.type=='seeked'?r2(m.currentTime):Math.floor(m.currentTime);const M=()=>document.querySelector('video,audio');const TG=e=>e.target===document?'doc':e.target===M()?'el':e.target.nodeName;const IN=['click','mousedown','mouseup','pointerdown','pointerup','dblclick'];const ME=['loadstart','error','loadedmetadata','loadeddata','canplay','playing','waiting','seeking','seeked','ended','durationchange','play','pause','ratechange','volumechange'];function log(m,tag,e){L.push((tag?tag+':':'')+e.type+'@'+TG(e)+' t='+(+e.isTrusted)+' p='+(+m.paused)+' ct='+CT(m,e)+(m.muted?' M':'')+' v='+m.volume)}function watch(m){ME.concat(IN).forEach(n=>m.addEventListener(n,e=>log(m,'',e)));IN.forEach(n=>document.addEventListener(n,e=>log(m,'D',e),true))}</script><video id=v src=long.mp4 controls preload=auto></video><script>watch(v)</script>

M':'')+' v='+m.volume)}function watch(m){ME.concat(IN).forEach(n=>m.addEventListener(n,e=>log(m,'',e)));IN.forEach(n=>document.addEventListener(n,e=>log(m,'D',e),true))}</script><script>for(const t of ['focus','blur','focusin','focusout'])document.addEventListener(t,e=>L.push('F:'+t+'@'+(e.target===document?'doc':e.target.nodeName)+' a='+document.activeElement.nodeName),true)</script><input id=i><video id=v src=long.mp4 controls preload=auto></video><script>watch(v)</script>
